Omitting 0-Axis Grid Voltage (v ) from the Control Loop 0 The the impact omitting the q- and d-axis cases were trivial assuming stiff q- and d-axis components at the grid end. However, in the presence of a CM disturbance, the 0-axis component of the voltage cannot be constant. For mitigation of E2 disturbances, it is recommended that at least the 0- axis voltage be used in the feedback loop. Otherwise, direct stability analysis may become intractably complex. However, if only E3 mitigation is required, v may be omitted from the feedback loop to reduce cost.
